metadata.question: Does Houston show higher nighttime light intensity in December 2012 and 2013 compared to the average light output during other months from 2012 to 2014?

- Collection: Try NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG (stray-light corrected, monthly) for 2012-01-01 to 2015-01-01. Fallback to NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG if empty.
- Location: Houston, TX point (-95.3698, 29.7604) buffered 30 km.
- Key subsets: December 2012, December 2013, and "other months" (all months in 2012–2014 excluding those two Decembers).

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- VIIRS monthly composites are already cloud-free. Use all non-null pixels; no additional masking. Use pixel counts (non-null) to validate C2.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collections exist but reduceRegion returns null/NaN for means, output C3.
- If images exist but valid pixel counts are zero, output C2.
- If no images for a required subset (Dec 2012, Dec 2013, or Other Months), output C1.
- Otherwise compare: both Dec 2012 and Dec 2013 means must exceed the mean of "other months" to answer Yes (A); otherwise No (B).

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function getInfoAsync(obj) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    obj.getInfo((res, err) => {
      if (err) reject(err);
      else resolve(res);
    });
  });
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const houston = ee.Geometry.Point([-95.3698, 29.7604]).buffer(30000); // ~30 km radius
    const start = '2012-01-01';
    const end = '2015-01-01';

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback
    async function getMonthlyCollection(start, end) {
      const datasets = [
        'NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG',
        'NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG'
      ];
      for (const ds of datasets) {
        const col = ee.ImageCollection(ds).filterDate(start, end).select(['avg_rad']);
        const size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
        if (size > 0) {
          return { col, dataset: ds, size };
        }
      }
      return null;
    }

    const result = await getMonthlyCollection(start, end);
    if (!result) {
      console.log('Base Images 2012–2014: 0');
      console.log('No monthly VIIRS data found in range/location.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    const baseCol = result.col;
    const datasetUsed = result.dataset;
    const baseSize = result.size;

    // Add year/month properties
    const withProps = baseCol.map(img => {
      const d = img.date();
      return img.set({ year: d.get('year'), month: d.get('month') });
    });

    // Subsets
    const dec2012Col = withProps
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('year', 2012))
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('month', 12));
    const dec2013Col = withProps
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('year', 2013))
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('month', 12));

    const exclDecs = ee.Filter.or(
      ee.Filter.and(ee.Filter.eq('year', 2012), ee.Filter.eq('month', 12)),
      ee.Filter.and(ee.Filter.eq('year', 2013), ee.Filter.eq('month', 12))
    );
    const othersCol = withProps
      .filter(ee.Filter.gte('year', 2012))
      .filter(ee.Filter.lte('year', 2014))
      .filter(ee.Filter.not(exclDecs));

    const dec2012Size = await getInfoAsync(dec2012Col.size());
    const dec2013Size = await getInfoAsync(dec2013Col.size());
    const othersSize = await getInfoAsync(othersCol.size());

    console.log(`Dataset: ${datasetUsed}`);
    console.log(`Base Images 2012–2014: ${baseSize}`);
    console.log(`Dec 2012 Images: ${dec2012Size}`);
    console.log(`Dec 2013 Images: ${dec2013Size}`);
    console.log(`Other Months Images: ${othersSize}`);

    if (dec2012Size === 0 || dec2013Size === 0 || othersSize === 0) {
      console.log('Missing one or more required subsets.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // Helper to compute mean and count for a single image
    async function imgMeanCount(img) {
      const dict = await getInfoAsync(
        img.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }),
          geometry: houston,
          scale: 1000,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        })
      );
      const mean = dict && dict.avg_rad_mean;
      const count = dict && dict.avg_rad_count;
      return { mean, count };
    }

    // Dec 2012 stats
    const dec2012Img = ee.Image(dec2012Col.first());
    const dec2012Stats = await imgMeanCount(dec2012Img);
    // Dec 2013 stats
    const dec2013Img = ee.Image(dec2013Col.first());
    const dec2013Stats = await imgMeanCount(dec2013Img);

    // Others: compute per-image regional means and counts, then average the means
    const othersWithStats = othersCol.map(img => {
      const reduce = img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }),
        geometry: houston,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });
      return img.set({
        regMean: reduce.get('avg_rad_mean'),
        pixCount: reduce.get('avg_rad_count')
      });
    });

    const othersMeanOfMeans = await getInfoAsync(othersWithStats.aggregate_mean('regMean'));
    const othersValidMonths = await getInfoAsync(
      othersWithStats.filter(ee.Filter.gt('pixCount', 0)).size()
    );
    const dec2012Count = dec2012Stats.count || 0;
    const dec2013Count = dec2013Stats.count || 0;

    console.log(`Dec 2012 Mean(avg_rad): ${dec2012Stats.mean !== null ? Number(dec2012Stats.mean).toFixed(3) : 'null'}, Pixels: ${dec2012Count}`);
    console.log(`Dec 2013 Mean(avg_rad): ${dec2013Stats.mean !== null ? Number(dec2013Stats.mean).toFixed(3) : 'null'}, Pixels: ${dec2013Count}`);
    console.log(`Other Months Mean(avg of monthly means): ${othersMeanOfMeans !== null ? Number(othersMeanOfMeans).toFixed(3) : 'null'}, Valid Months: ${othersValidMonths}`);

    // Valid pixel checks (C2)
    if (dec2012Count === 0 || dec2013Count === 0 || othersValidMonths === 0) {
      console.log('No valid pixels after processing in one or more subsets.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // Calculation failure checks (C3)
    function isBad(x) {
      return x === null || x === undefined || Number.isNaN(Number(x));
    }
    if (isBad(dec2012Stats.mean) || isBad(dec2013Stats.mean) || isBad(othersMeanOfMeans)) {
      console.log('Computation returned null/NaN for one or more means.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Final comparison
    const dec12 = Number(dec2012Stats.mean);
    const dec13 = Number(dec2013Stats.mean);
    const othersMean = Number(othersMeanOfMeans);

    const bothHigher = dec12 > othersMean && dec13 > othersMean;
    console.log(`Compare: Dec2012>${othersMean.toFixed(3)}? ${dec12 > othersMean}; Dec2013>${othersMean.toFixed(3)}? ${dec13 > othersMean}`);

    if (bothHigher) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
